name: shared-axis-z
description: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

vars.description: Which way the words travel along the z axis: in swells up from small, out settles down from large.
Scales how far the words start from their final size, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
